title: Pick your unit and dim the map
breadcrumb: Pick your unit and dim the map

slides.title: Find the unit setting
slides.html: Tap Inbox at the bottom left, then Set your unit to watch its area ›.

slides.title: Go into your platoon
slides.html: Tap › at the right of your platoon's row to go into it. Tapping the row itself picks that unit.

slides.title: Pick your unit
slides.html: Tap your squad, or your platoon's card at the top if you lead it.

slides.title: See what your unit reports
slides.html: The Inbox now watches 1J and counts its reports under Reported by your unit. Tap Done.

slides.title: Check your marks
slides.html: Tap Markers on the bar at the bottom and pick Friendly. Unit now shows 1J, so the friendly marks you place belong to 1J unless you pick another unit.

slides.title: Change it later
slides.html: To change your unit later, tap ≡, scroll the tools to OpenDefence Main and tap your unit under My unit, here 1J. The last row of the list that opens, No unit, clears it.

slides.title: Dim the map
slides.html: Under Wash out the map, pick how pale the map is, here 50 %.

slides.title: Check the map
slides.html: Close the pane with ✕ to see your arrow and other marks stand out on the paler map. To bring the map back, open OpenDefence Main again and pick Off.
